summary: Elemental Royalty Corporation filed a Form 6-K with the SEC attaching a news release dated November 3, 2026, announcing it will release its Q3 2026 results after market close on November 10, 2026, with an investor webcast and Q&A on November 11, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor are disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings-scheduling notice for a gold-focused streaming and royalty company listed on Nasdaq and TSX under ELE; no risk-arb angle applies.
